items.title: Don Albert and Herbert Hall Interview, 1978-08-03
items.q: Jack helped us in a lot of ways. He was a strong guy. Helping for God, they helped help us to set up first. Took care of the fighting for the love.

ctx.x: He'd run all the way to Dallas. In fact, he got there before he did because it practically broke down entirely. Well, did Jack A live anywhere? Jack was having to know all these things.
I ain't never known him before in my life. You just found him. Yeah, I just found him. I needed transportation.
